title: 第一卷 第19章 洗清嫌疑第一卷 第20章 杀人立威
lines: 随着秦玄一声令下，马上就有人当着所有人的面在丹药坊的架子上带着化灵丹过来。
“诸位请看，这是我们秦家的炼制的化灵丹。”
秦玄说着，打开瓷瓶，将丹药放到一旁。
几颗蓝色丹药露了出来。
“看，这不就是你们秦家的丹药吗？怎么，少族长还想抵赖不成？”
杀破狼高叫着，越发得意起来。
其他人也有些不解。
本来别人就已经将这件事扣到了秦家头上，秦玄不仅不大事化小，小事化了，竟然让公开将丹药给拿了出来。
这不是反而把事情给闹大了吗？
杀破狼的喊叫声在附近吸引来了一片附和的声音。
“诸位，对于丹药来说，最重要的是什么？”
秦玄的目光看向四周，打断了杀破狼的话。
不能被对方牵着鼻子走，得主动出击!
“当然是药材，药材的好坏决定着这颗丹药的下限，用上好药材炼制的丹药品质自然远胜那些用劣质材质做成的丹药！”
“化灵丹虽然不是我们秦家最珍贵的丹药，不过这颗丹药所使用的药材都极为扎实，其中更是有一味天蓝花，配合着地脉之火炼制之后，便会让丹药通体湛蓝。”
秦玄朝着四周说着。
化灵丹并不是多高等的丹药，丹方不少丹师都知道，附近人中也有不少懂一些丹药知识的，也是纷纷点头。
“秦少族长，还是别说废话了，说了这么多，不会是想要抵赖吧？怎么，你们秦家这么大的一个家族，总不会不认账吧。”
杀破狼本能地察觉到了一些不妙，急忙就像打断秦玄的话。
“哼，抵赖，今天我就让你彻底死心！”
秦玄冷哼一声，拿起一枚化灵丹。
“我们秦家的化灵丹之所以和别家化灵丹不同，靠的正是这火风城独一无二的地脉之火，炼制出来的化灵丹正是通体蓝色。”
“可要是火焰发生变化，丹药中的天蓝花颜色便会跟着变化，来人，带火上来！”
秦玄说着冷冷下令。
几个杂役急忙去后面取火源。
看到秦玄竟然这么懂行，杀破狼这十几人就都有些慌了。
“妈的，这次就当老子栽了，没想到你们秦家这么霸道，我们野狼帮认了，兄弟们，走！”
杀破狼神色有些慌张地挥了挥手，示意其他人跟他一起离开。
到了这时候，秦玄怎么会让他们离开。
“都给我站住！”
秦玄冷冷呵斥。
“谁敢离开，今天我就宰了他，不要以为我不敢，柳家祖坟我都敢挖，更别说你们！”
说着，他挥了挥手，十几个秦家侍卫已经冲上去，将这些人给团团围住。
“大家都看看啊，秦家实在是太霸道了，吃了他家的药死了人不说，现在还想要杀人灭口！”
杀破狼见状还想煽动周围的人，可是当他和秦玄那冰冷的视线对视的瞬间，整个人立即如坠冰窖。
这人是真的会杀了他的！
“你怕什么？今天这么多人在这里做个见证，要真是我们秦家的丹药，以命抵命也不是不可以。”
“可要是没有，那也得以命抵命！”
content_en:
Following Qin Xuan's order, someone immediately came over with the Spirit Transformation Pill on the shelf of the elixir shop in front of everyone.
"Everyone, please see, this is the elixir refined by our Qin family."
Qin Xuan said, opened the porcelain bottle and put the elixir aside.
Several blue pills were exposed.
"Look, isn't this the elixir of your Qin family? Why, the young patriarch still wants to deny it?"
Sha Po Lang shouted, becoming more and more proud.
Others were also a little puzzled.
Others had already blamed the Qin family for this matter. Not only did Qin Xuan make it a trivial matter, he even let the elixir be taken out publicly.
Wouldn't this make things worse?
Sha Po Lang's shouts attracted a chorus of echoes from nearby.
"Everyone, what is the most important thing about elixirs?"
Qin Xuan looked around and interrupted Sha Po Lang's words.
You can’t be led by the other party, you have to take the initiative!
"Of course it's the medicinal materials. The quality of the medicinal materials determines the lower limit of the elixir. The quality of elixirs made from good medicinal materials is naturally far better than those made from inferior materials!"
"Although the Spiritual Transformation Pill is not the most precious pill in our Qin family, the medicinal materials used in this pill are very solid, and there is even a hint of sky blue flower in it. After being refined with the fire of the earth veins, the pill will be completely blue."
Qin Xuan said to the surroundings.
The Spiritual Transformation Pill is not a high-level pill, and many alchemists know about it. There are also many people nearby who know some knowledge about pills, and they all nodded.
"Chief Qin, you'd better stop talking nonsense. After saying so much, you don't want to deny it, right? Why, you, a family as big as the Qin family, will never deny it."
Sha Po Lang instinctively sensed something was wrong and hurriedly interrupted Qin Xuan's words.
"Hmph, deny it, I will make you give up completely today!"
Qin Xuan snorted coldly and picked up a spirit pill.
"The reason why our Qin family's Spirit Transformation Pill is different from other families' Spirit Transformation Pills is because it relies on the unique fire of the earth veins in Huofeng City. The refined Spirit Transformation Pill is completely blue."
"But if the flames change, the color of the azure flowers in the elixir will change accordingly. Someone, bring the fire!"
Qin Xuan said and ordered coldly.
Several handymen hurried to the back to get a fire source.
Seeing that Qin Xuan was so knowledgeable, Sha Po Lang and the dozen or so people panicked.
"Damn it, I'm going to be blamed this time. I didn't expect your Qin family to be so domineering. We, the Wild Wolf Gang, have recognized you. Brothers, let's go!"
Sha Po Lang waved his hand in a panic, gesturing for the others to leave with him.
At this time, how could Qin Xuan let them leave.
"Everyone, stop!"
Qin Xuan scolded him coldly.
"Whoever dares to leave, I will kill him today. Don't think that I dare not. I dare to dig the Liu family's ancestral graves, let alone you!"
As he spoke, he waved his hand, and a dozen Qin family guards rushed forward and surrounded these people.
"Everyone, take a look. The Qin family is really overbearing. People who took their medicine died without telling anyone, and now they want to kill people and silence them!"
Upon seeing this, Sha Po Lang wanted to incite the people around him, but the moment he met Qin Xuan's cold eyes, his whole body immediately felt as if he had fallen into an ice cellar.
This person would really kill him!
"What are you afraid of? There are so many people here today to bear witness. If it is really the elixir of our Qin family, it is not impossible to pay for it with one's life."
"But if not, it's still a life-for-life!"
